name: anti-forensic-privacy-demo
capture: Actual Android app with synthetic demo data. Shake injected through the emulator accelerometer.
demonstrated_actions: Open the weather cover with emulated shake
Review decoy and duress credential fields
limits: Duress credential and wipe are shown as configuration only; no wipe executed
No claim of forensic resistance is verified by this recording
editing: Navigation and waiting time removed. Selected setup scenes accelerated 1.5x; keyboard typing accelerated 6x. Android status bar replaced with demo chapter labels.

scenes.label: 01 / CALCULATOR COVER / ANDROID DEMO
scenes.en: A working calculator cover. The app stays behind its access gate.
scenes.it: Una calcolatrice funzionante come copertura. L’app resta dietro il suo accesso protetto.

scenes.label: 02 / SHAKE CAMOUFLAGE / ANDROID DEMO
scenes.en: Choose what a shake opens: tile puzzle, calculator, weather or grocery list.
scenes.it: Scegli cosa apre uno shake: puzzle, calcolatrice, meteo o lista della spesa.

scenes.label: 03 / EMULATED SHAKE / SAMPLE WEATHER
scenes.en: An emulated shake switches the app to its weather cover. Weather readings are sample data.
scenes.it: Uno shake emulato passa dall’app alla copertura meteo. I valori meteo sono dati di esempio.

scenes.label: 04 / MASTER PASSWORD / ANDROID DEMO
scenes.en: Set a local master password for protected sections. The password stays masked.
scenes.it: Imposta una master password locale per le sezioni protette. La password resta mascherata.

scenes.label: 04 / SECTION LOCKS / ANDROID DEMO
scenes.en: Choose which sections require the master password: Q-Note, Q-Pass and Q-Chat.
scenes.it: Scegli quali sezioni richiedono la master password: Q-Note, Q-Pass e Q-Chat.

scenes.label: 05 / UNLOCK PRIVATE NOTES / DEMO DATA
scenes.en: Q-Note shows a locked screen. Unlock it to load the private notes and previews.
scenes.it: Q-Note mostra la schermata di blocco. Sbloccalo per caricare note private e anteprime.

scenes.label: 06 / QUANTUM KEYBOARD / DEMO DRAFT
scenes.en: Type a draft with Quantum Keyboard. Its tools stay in the keyboard toolbar. Demo contact offline; message not sent.
scenes.it: Scrivi una bozza con Quantum Keyboard. Gli strumenti restano nella barra della tastiera. Contatto demo offline; messaggio non inviato.

scenes.label: 07 / ACCESS PROTOCOLS / CONFIGURATION ONLY
scenes.en: Separate fields for the primary PIN, duress wipe and decoy vault. Configuration only; no duress action triggered.
scenes.it: Campi separati per PIN principale, cancellazione sotto coercizione e vault esca. Solo configurazione; nessuna azione di coercizione attivata.

scenes.label: 08 / WIPE REVIEW / NO WIPE EXECUTED
scenes.en: Review what Factory Wipe removes and its limits. The confirmation remains unchecked; no wipe is executed.
scenes.it: Controlla cosa rimuove Factory Wipe e i suoi limiti. La conferma resta deselezionata; nessuna cancellazione viene eseguita.
